organization.name: SAP Concur / Concur Technologies
organization.parent: SAP SE; Frankfurt: SAP, NYSE ADR: SAP
organization.notes: Concur founded1993; SAP acquired company2014. Parent SAP public underSAP inFrankfurt/NYSEADR. American Express bought6.4million newly issued Concur shares in2008 (then13% equity); historical investor, not current ownership. SAP is current acquirer/parent.

pricingTiers.name: Base
pricingTiers.notes: US starting usage rate $7/report; varies with monthly report commitment. Unlimited users. This is not a $7 monthly subscription; monthly/annual totals withheld.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Plus
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational upgrade: starting $11/report, varies by monthly commitment; includes ExpenseIt/reporting. Usage rate, not fixed subscription.

pricingTiers.name: Premium
pricingTiers.notes: Custom-priced most advanced package; includes Expense, Travel, ExpenseIt and Intelligence. No numeric subscription or report rate published.

moats.claim: Connections among expense policies, corporate travel and enterprise accounting can create integration and compliance-process switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Mobile receipt capture and automatic extraction reduce manual preparation of expense reports.
Policy checks and structured approvals make spending rules part of report submission.
Premium joins travel and expense reporting with business intelligence for broader visibility into employee spend.
